route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/s81sl_capc5g/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/s81sl_capc5g/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/s81sl_capc5g --out {RUN}/record/views/ot_s81sl_capc5c --macro-view physical/ref_tile/s81sl_cap_ed/views/ot_s81sl_cap_ed --macro-view physical/ref_tile/s81sl_cap_ld/views/ot_s81sl_cap_ld --macro-view physical/ref_tile/s81sl_cap_rt/views/ot_s81sl_cap_rt --macro-view physical/ref_tile/s81sl_cap_tr/views/ot_s81sl_cap_tr > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: S81-TILES-D 10-20 s81sl_capc5g: capc5e (W-face ck_rt entry) + (1) ck_rt REGIONAL ROOTS inside the rt region: physical/common_flow/clock_split_km.tcl K=2 on ck_rt (compact sink clusters = the N band above u_rt and the S band below it, one BUFx24 local root per cluster under a balanced top tree; capc5e/5f soft-flop spread 115 ps came from one TritonCTS tree spanning both bands around the 259-um u_rt); same port/clock/region/landings/cycles; (2) GRT repair fix: landing-local kept flops are dont_touch (ot_keep_regs) so post-GRT repair_design could not buffer their driver (RSZ-3006 u_lpl_11_r ... u_local/_018_ in EVERY capc5b..f trial GRT); pre_grt releases dont_touch on u_lpl_* cells (cells and nets unchanged). S81-TILES-B 10-20 VARIANT E = capc5c with the ck_rt entry moved from the S face (x185) to the W face at y95-97, in the W channel beside u_rt between the two rt register bands (S band y~10-40 under u_rt, N band y~150-200 above it): capc5c/5d gates FAILED ck_rt TT 131/FF 108 pin-flop spread because the S-face entry reached the N band only around the 250-um-wide u_rt. Same RTL (ot_s81sl_capc5c), regions, children, landings. S81-CAPC5 10-20 VARIANT C of the LANDED capc parent (tools/landed_parent/specs/ot_s81sl_capc5c.json from flat ot_s81sl_capc5cf): capc5b gate 03:2x FAILED clock with cw 49/49 PASS but core 134/120 and rt 178/150 (a region holding a hard child or u_rt together with a full face of pin registers gets ~100+ ps TritonCTS soft spread). C = 5 LOCAL regions: rt (u_rt + landing rings only), cw (W face regs + u_ld3 + u_tw, as B PASS), ce (E face regs + u_te + u_ed), rn (N face: cfg in-regs + N out-regs), rs (S face out-regs + fault). Every u_rt output face is now LANDED into its own face region (S +3 vs capc5b: all outputs W+8 = +6 vs capc2; inputs unchanged). rt reset loads 45 -> lp regional_reset_copies (2 kept copies, same reset age, no added edge). n32 ring writer kept (native32).
